sql: WITH RECURSIVE daily_net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM daily_net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d FROM spine WHERE d<(SELECT MAX(d) FROM daily_net)), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.d,s.first_d,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM filled), rolling AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days,AVG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,SUM(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) sum30 FROM balance), monthly_max AS (SELECT customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg30,0)) max_avg30 FROM rolling WHERE days=30 AND date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY customer_id,m) SELECT m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(max_avg30) total,MIN(max_avg30) minimum,MAX(max_avg30) maximum FROM monthly_max GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

WITH RECURSIVE daily_net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM daily_net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d FROM spine WHERE d<(SELECT MAX(d) FROM daily_net)), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.d,s.first_d,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM filled), rolling AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days,AVG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,SUM(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) sum30 FROM balance), monthly_max AS (SELECT customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg30,0)) max_avg30 FROM rolling WHERE days=30 AND date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY customer_id,m) SELECT customer_id,d,net,closing,days,sum30,avg30,MAX(avg30,0) clipped FROM rolling WHERE customer_id IN(1,3,10) AND d BETWEEN date(first_d,'+27 days') AND date(first_d,'+31 days') ORDER BY customer_id,d

WITH RECURSIVE daily_net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM daily_net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d FROM spine WHERE d<(SELECT MAX(d) FROM daily_net)), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.d,s.first_d,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM filled), rolling AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days,AVG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,SUM(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) sum30 FROM balance), monthly_max AS (SELECT customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg30,0)) max_avg30 FROM rolling WHERE days=30 AND date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY customer_id,m) SELECT date(first_d,'start of month') baseline_month,COUNT(*) customers,MIN(first_d) first_start,MAX(first_d) last_start,MIN(last_d) earliest_end,MAX(last_d) latest_end FROM bounds GROUP BY baseline_month UNION ALL SELECT 'same_day_multiple_transactions',COUNT(*),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL FROM (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date),COUNT(*) n FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,date(txn_date) HAVING n>1)

WITH RECURSIVE daily_net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM daily_net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d FROM spine WHERE d<(SELECT MAX(d) FROM daily_net)), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.d,s.first_d,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM filled), rolling AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days,AVG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,SUM(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) sum30 FROM balance), monthly_max AS (SELECT customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg30,0)) max_avg30 FROM rolling WHERE days=30 AND date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY customer_id,m) SELECT a.customer_id,a.d,a.sum30 window_sum,(SELECT SUM(b.closing) FROM balance b WHERE b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.d BETWEEN date(a.d,'-29 days') AND a.d) independent_range_sum,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM balance b WHERE b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.d BETWEEN date(a.d,'-29 days') AND a.d) range_days,(SELECT SUM(MAX(b.closing,0))/30.0 FROM balance b WHERE b.customer_id=a.customer_id AND b.d BETWEEN date(a.d,'-29 days') AND a.d) clip_daily_before_avg,MAX(a.avg30,0) clip_after_avg FROM rolling a WHERE (a.customer_id=3 AND a.d='2020-02-25') OR (a.customer_id=10 AND a.d='2020-02-11') OR (a.customer_id=1 AND a.d='2020-01-31')

WITH RECURSIVE daily_net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM daily_net GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d FROM spine WHERE d<(SELECT MAX(d) FROM daily_net)), filled AS (SELECT s.customer_id,s.d,s.first_d,COALESCE(n.net,0) net FROM spine s LEFT JOIN daily_net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), balance AS (SELECT *,SUM(net) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) closing FROM filled), rolling AS (SELECT *,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) days,AVG(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,SUM(closing) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) sum30 FROM balance), monthly_max AS (SELECT customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg30,0)) max_avg30 FROM rolling WHERE days=30 AND date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY customer_id,m) SELECT m month,SUM(max_avg30) total_max_avg30 FROM monthly_max GROUP BY m ORDER BY m

WITH RECURSIVE dates(day) AS (SELECT MIN(txn_date) FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(day,'+1 day') FROM dates WHERE day < (SELECT MAX(txn_date) FROM customer_transactions)), txn AS (SELECT customer_id, txn_date, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date), cust AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS first_d, MAX(txn_date) AS last_d FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id, d.day, c.first_d FROM cust c JOIN dates d ON d.day BETWEEN c.first_d AND c.last_d), bal AS (SELECT s.customer_id, s.day, s.first_d, SUM(COALESCE(t.net,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.day) AS balance FROM spine s LEFT JOIN txn t ON t.customer_id=s.customer_id AND t.txn_date=s.day), roll AS (SELECT customer_id, day, first_d, AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ravg, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cnt FROM bal), daily AS (SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m',day) AS month, first_d, CASE WHEN ravg<0 THEN 0 ELSE ravg END AS floored FROM roll WHERE cnt=30), per_cm AS (SELECT customer_id, month, MAX(floored) AS mx FROM daily WHERE month <> strftime('%Y-%m', first_d) GROUP BY customer_id, month) SELECT month AS month, ROUND(SUM(mx),2) AS total_max_30day_avg_balance FROM per_cm GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), endpoints AS (SELECT 'customer_last' mode,customer_id,first_d,last_d end_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'global_last',customer_id,first_d,(SELECT MAX(d) FROM net) FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_month_end',customer_id,first_d,date(last_d,'start of month','+1 month','-1 day') FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'global_month_end',customer_id,first_d,(SELECT date(MAX(d),'start of month','+1 month','-1 day') FROM net) FROM bounds), spine(mode,customer_id,d,first_d,end_d) AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,first_d,first_d,end_d FROM endpoints UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d,end_d FROM spine WHERE d<end_d), bal AS (SELECT s.*,SUM(COALESCE(n.net,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY s.mode,s.customer_id ORDER BY s.d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), roll AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d) rn,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg31 FROM bal), variants AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'30_at30' win,avg30 avg_balance FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at30',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at31',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=31), cm AS (SELECT mode,win,customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg_balance,0)) mx FROM variants WHERE date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY mode,win,customer_id,m) SELECT mode,win,m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(mx) total FROM cm GROUP BY mode,win,m ORDER BY mode,win,m

WITH RECURSIVE net AS (SELECT customer_id,date(txn_date) d,SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id,d), bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(d) first_d,MAX(d) last_d FROM net GROUP BY customer_id), endpoints AS (SELECT 'customer_last_plus1' mode,customer_id,first_d,date(last_d,'+1 day') end_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_start_minus1',customer_id,date(first_d,'-1 day'),last_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_minus1_plus1',customer_id,date(first_d,'-1 day'),date(last_d,'+1 day') FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'month_start_customer_last',customer_id,date(first_d,'start of month'),last_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT 'month_start_customer_plus1',customer_id,date(first_d,'start of month'),date(last_d,'+1 day') FROM bounds), spine(mode,customer_id,d,first_d,end_d) AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,first_d,first_d,end_d FROM endpoints UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d,end_d FROM spine WHERE d<end_d), bal AS (SELECT s.*,SUM(COALESCE(n.net,0)) OVER(PARTITION BY s.mode,s.customer_id ORDER BY s.d ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) balance FROM spine s LEFT JOIN net n ON s.customer_id=n.customer_id AND s.d=n.d), roll AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d) rn,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY mode,customer_id ORDER BY d ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg31 FROM bal), variants AS (SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'30_at30' win,avg30 avg_balance FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at30',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT mode,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at31',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=31), cm AS (SELECT mode,win,customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg_balance,0)) mx FROM variants WHERE date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY mode,win,customer_id,m) SELECT mode,win,m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(mx) total FROM cm GROUP BY mode,win,m ORDER BY mode,win,m

WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(txn_date) first_d,MAX(txn_date) last_d FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d,last_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d,last_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d,last_d FROM spine WHERE d<last_d), rawrows AS (SELECT s.*,COALESCE(t.rowid,0) transaction_row,COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE -t.txn_amount END,0) amount FROM spine s LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t ON s.customer_id=t.customer_id AND s.d=t.txn_date), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) day_closing,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) transaction_closing FROM rawrows), kinds AS (SELECT 'daily_range' kind,*,day_closing balance FROM balances UNION ALL SELECT 'transaction_rows',*,transaction_closing FROM balances), roll AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row) rn,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg31 FROM kinds), variants AS (SELECT kind,customer_id,d,first_d,'30_at30' win,avg30 avg_balance FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT kind,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at30',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=30 UNION ALL SELECT kind,customer_id,d,first_d,'31_at31',avg31 FROM roll WHERE rn>=31), cm AS (SELECT kind,win,customer_id,date(d,'start of month') m,MAX(MAX(avg_balance,0)) mx FROM variants WHERE date(d,'start of month')>date(first_d,'start of month') GROUP BY kind,win,customer_id,m) SELECT kind,win,m,COUNT(*) customers,SUM(mx) total FROM cm GROUP BY kind,win,m ORDER BY kind,win,m

WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (SELECT customer_id,MIN(txn_date) first_d,MAX(txn_date) last_d FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id), spine(customer_id,d,first_d,last_d) AS (SELECT customer_id,first_d,first_d,last_d FROM bounds UNION ALL SELECT customer_id,date(d,'+1 day'),first_d,last_d FROM spine WHERE d<last_d), rawrows AS (SELECT s.*,COALESCE(t.rowid,0) transaction_row,COALESCE(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE -t.txn_amount END,0) amount FROM spine s LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t ON s.customer_id=t.customer_id AND s.d=t.txn_date), balances AS (SELECT *,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) day_closing,SUM(amount) OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) transaction_closing FROM rawrows), kinds AS (SELECT 'daily_range' kind,*,day_closing balance FROM balances UNION ALL SELECT 'transaction_rows',*,transaction_closing FROM balances), roll AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row) rn,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg30,AVG(balance) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) avg31,COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) rows31,MIN(d) OVER(PARTITION BY kind,customer_id ORDER BY d,transaction_row ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) first_window_day FROM kinds) SELECT kind,customer_id,d,transaction_row,rn,rows31,first_window_day,CAST(julianday(d)-julianday(first_window_day)+1 AS INTEGER) calendar_span,balance,avg30,avg31 FROM roll WHERE kind='daily_range' AND rn>=30 AND julianday(d)-julianday(first_window_day)+1<30 ORDER BY customer_id,d,transaction_row LIMIT 12
